why: phase-509 P9b item 4 / RFC-0108 "As built in P9b" -- the callbacks registered from now on belong to preemption level `level`: a level runner sets each level up in turn on the core's ONE executor, and each level's worker then runs exactly what its setup registered (authored tiers carry no ranks, so a band of dispatch levels cannot separate them). rclcpp assigns callbacks to executors by callback group; rclrs has one executor thread.
